STEP 6 - Grams: almonds are dense, about 0.65 g/ml as a bulk pile. Per piece, a real almond weighs about 1.2 g, so 22 x 1.2 ≈ 26 g. I'll use about 26 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: almonds are about 579 kcal per 100 g, so 26 g ≈ 150 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: about 22 almonds is roughly a 25 g handful, which fits and is plausible.
